about.body: I'm Francis, but most friends call me Cisco. I'm from Tanzania and currently study at Don State Technical University in Russia. I build websites, work on products and help people sort out computer problems.
about.approachBody: I ask questions before I start building. Who will use this? What do they need to do? Then I work through the design and code, and check it on a phone as well as a laptop.
about.globalBody: Growing up in Tanzania and continuing my education in Russia has given me a personal connection to building across cultures. I bring that curiosity to each project, and keep learning through practical work.
about.languageBody: I speak English and Kiswahili fluently, and a little French.
